keySignatures

Class KeySignatures

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.AbstractMap<K,V>
      • java.util.HashMap<KeySignature,java.util.SortedSet<java.lang.String>>
        • keySignatures.KeySignatures
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.util.Map<KeySignature,java.util.SortedSet<java.lang.String>>

    public class KeySignatures
extends java.util.HashMap<KeySignature,java.util.SortedSet<java.lang.String>>
    This class analyzes a given MEI/MSM to find out which key signatures are present. The entry format is (KeySignature, List of MEI file names where the key signature is present).

      • match

        public static boolean match(meico.mei.Mei mei,
                            meico.msm.Msm msm)
        Match the key signature that is encoded in MEI to the key signature that is automatically analyzed from the provided MSM. This method can be used to identify key signature-related encoding errors in the MEI.
        Parameters:
        mei - the MEI to be analyzed
        msm - the MSM should correspond with the MEI
        Returns:
        true if the result is identical, else false
